title: Trying to rotate child scenes with path3D root creates new path point instead
body:
### Tested versions

4.5 beta1
4.2.2
3.5 

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

Trying to rotate a child scene where the child's root node is a Path3D (or Path in v3.5) results in the creation of a new point in the path instead of rotating the child scene

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new scene, make the root node a Path3D.
Add 2 points to the path and save the scene. 

Create a new 3D scene with a Node3D root.
Add the path scene as a child. Make sure this is selected.
Hold down CTRL and attempt to rotate the child scene using the grab handles. Instead of rotating the scene, an additional path point is added to the child node. If you now open the child scene you will see that the path has 3 points.

(If you start rotating the child scene and then press CTRL while the mouse is held down, the scene will rotate as expected without adding path points).


![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e6182e77-1d7f-407a-a5f0-db98174fd194)

---
In 3.5 I did not have to hold CTRL in the parent scene when trying to rotate the child, clicking anywhere resulted in a path point being created at that point.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

2 versions of the project are attached, one for v3.5 and one for v4.5 beta 1
